Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to the special Council meeting on Monday, May 26,
Individuals interested in participating in the meeting were eligible to register online
using the delegation registration form at www.kitchener.ca slash delegation or via email
at delegation at kitchener.ca.
Any written comments received prior to the commencement of the meeting have been circulated
to members of Council prior to the meeting and will form part of the public record.
The meeting live stream and archived videos are available at www.kitchener.ca.
Before we begin this afternoon's meeting, I'd like to acknowledge that today we're
gathering on the traditional territory of the neutral Anishinaabeg and Haudenosaunee
peoples.
We recognize our responsibility to serve as stewards for the land and honour the original
caretakers who came before us. Our community is enriched by the enduring knowledge and
deep-rooted traditions of the diverse First Nations, Métis and Inuit in Kitchener today.
Are there any disclosures of pecuniary interest? There being none and there being no delegations
and there being no mayoral business in this special council meeting, we'll move right
to the in-camera meeting authorization. And there are four items to go in-camera for,
advice, information supplied in confidence by a third party and instruction for negotiations
and to personnel matters. Is there someone to move going in camera?
Moved by Councillor Stretch, seconded by Councillor Schnider.
Any discussion? All those in favour? Any opposed? That's carried.
Motion to recess moved by Councillor Michaud, seconded by Councillor Ioannidis.
All those in favour? Opposed? That's carried.
And we'll now reconvene the meeting in the Conestoga Room for the Public Strategic Session
on the Kitchener Indoor Recreational Complex. Thank you.
Thank you.
